props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][LifeTransference]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const CRISIS_EFFECT_ID = "5jkr80zqdzaR003d";

const CRISIS_NAME_FALLBACK = "Crisis";

// --------------------------------------------------

// Resolve caster

// --------------------------------------------------

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

""

);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.");

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Read Brainwave Clock + Level

// --------------------------------------------------

const clockRaw = attackerActor?.system?.props?.clock_brainwave ?? 0;

const brainwave = Math.max(0, parseInt(clockRaw, 10) || 0);

const levelRaw =

attackerActor?.system?.props?.level ??

attackerActor?.system?.level ??

attackerActor?.level ??

0;

const level = Math.max(0, parseInt(levelRaw, 10) || 0);

// Psychic Gifts cost rule: minimum 5 MP

const mpCost = Math.max(5, brainwave * 5);

// Psychic Gifts scaling:

// +10 at level 20+, +20 at level 40+

let levelBonus = 0;

if (level >= 40) levelBonus = 20;

else if (level >= 20) levelBonus = 10;

// Base heal formula from skill text

const healAmount = 5 + (brainwave * 5) + levelBonus;

// --------------------------------------------------

// Apply dynamic cost override for ResourceGate

// --------------------------------------------------

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta.costRawOverride = `${mpCost} mp`;

p.meta.costRawFinal = `${mpCost} mp`;

// --------------------------------------------------

// Resolve target

// --------------------------------------------------

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid =

targetUuids[0] ??

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

"";

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc ?? attackerActor;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.");

p.advPayload.baseValue = "+0";

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Crisis check

// - effect id first

// - uuid fallback

// - name fallback

// --------------------------------------------------

const effects = Array.from(targetActor.effects ?? []);

const crisisEffect = effects.find((e) => {

const id = String(e?.id ?? e?._id ?? "").trim();

const uuid = String(e?.uuid ?? "").trim();

const name = String(e?.name ?? e?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

return (

id === CRISIS_EFFECT_ID ||

uuid === CRISIS_EFFECT_ID ||

uuid.endsWith(`.${CRISIS_EFFECT_ID}`) ||

name === CRISIS_NAME_FALLBACK.toLowerCase()

);

});

const isInCrisis = !!crisisEffect;

// --------------------------------------------------

// Apply healing payload

// --------------------------------------------------

if (isInCrisis) {

p.advPayload.baseValue = `+${healAmount}`;

} else {

p.advPayload.baseValue = "+0";

}

// Optional debug marker

p.meta.lifeTransferenceDebug = {

attacker: attackerActor?.name ?? null,

target: targetActor?.name ?? null,

brainwave,

level,

levelBonus,

mpCost,

isInCrisis,

healApplied: isInCrisis ? healAmount : 0

};

console.log(TAG, "RESULT", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

target: targetActor?.name,

brainwave,

level,

levelBonus,

mpCost,

isInCrisis,

healApplied: isInCrisis ? healAmount : 0,

costRawOverride: p?.meta?.costRawOverride,

costRawFinal: p?.meta?.costRawFinal,

baseValue: p?.advPayload?.baseValue

});
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][LIFE-TRANSFERENCE][BRAINWAVE]";

const p = __PAYLOAD ?? {};

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker UUID in payload.", { payload: p });

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

const currentClock = Math.max(

0,

Number(attackerActor.system?.props?.clock_brainwave ?? 0) || 0

);

const newClock = Math.min(4, currentClock + 1);

await attackerActor.update({

"system.props.clock_brainwave": String(newClock)

});

console.log(TAG, "Brainwave Clock updated.", {

actor: attackerActor.name,

before: currentClock,

after: newClock

});
